reviewId.description: Stable Google review identifier. Always returned regardless of includePersonalData.

placeName.description: Business name from the Google Maps place header.

placeDataId.description: Google Maps internal data ID in 0x...:0x... format used for review extraction.

placeAddress.description: Full postal address as shown on the place panel.

placeReviewCount.description: Total review count Google reports for the place.

reviewerName.description: Reviewer display name. Null when includePersonalData is false.

reviewerUrl.description: Reviewer Google Maps profile URL. Null when includePersonalData is false.

reviewerPhotoUrl.description: Reviewer profile photo URL. Null when includePersonalData is false.

reviewerHash.description: Stable reviewer hash when the selected source supplies an author ID or name; null when reviewer identity is unavailable.

reviewerReviewCount.description: Lifetime review count of the reviewer across Google Maps, if reported.

text.description: Review body text. Null for star-only reviews with no written content.

language.description: Detected review language code when Google provides it.

publishedAtText.description: Relative publish date as Google renders it (e.g., 'a month ago').

publishedAt.description: Approximate ISO-8601 UTC timestamp derived from the relative label.

ownerResponse.description: Owner reply text if present, else null.

ownerResponseAt.description: Approximate ISO-8601 timestamp of the owner reply.

likesCount.description: Number of 'likes' on the review if Google surfaces it.

sentimentHint.description: Rating-derived coarse sentiment bucket. 'positive' for 4–5, 'neutral' for 3, 'negative' for 1–2. Not ML-derived — purely from rating.

reviewUrl.description: Permalink to this specific review on Google Maps.

scrapedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when this record was scraped.

extractionSource.description: Internal extraction route used for the review, either listugcposts or boq.
